effort.meaning: Actual active person-minutes; setup and unmatched work retained. Missing phases suppress paired comparison; signed changes remain signed.

fleet.limits: Source-based observation and human review. Calendar rental time, engine meters, productive work, useful output, downtime, recognised cost and cash are separate. Comparative arithmetic does not establish causality or a proprietary risk score.

limits: Independent supplied-record fleet study. Asset identity, configuration, actual work, useful output, downtime, costs, cash and historical human review remain distinct.
